issues.on_page: Change in Payables 614,630 (Other Financing Sources, Total column)
issues.issue: Recorded as printed and needed for the identity, but this is an accrual: construction payables (the reconciliation adds the same 614,630 to Accounts Payable on p1). It is not a cash financing source.

The whole amount is paid from the Debt Service (construction) fund in the district's first period, so it is probably utility infrastructure installation (capital outlay), not operating utility service.
